top_story: Escalating fighting in Yemen has already displaced more than 100,000 people, pushing families onto dangerous sea routes to Djibouti, and the Houthi seizure of Greater and Lesser Hanish near Bab al-Mandab now extends that conflict from a humanitarian emergency into a direct threat to Red Sea shipping and oil flows. Hours later, Washington’s planned $2.8 billion arms sale to Israel, including 40,000 MK-84 2,000-pound bombs, reinforced a wider regional posture centered on confrontation with Iran and its allied networks.
